notes.title: Work on Chapter 3 is nearing completion!
notes.notes: [p]Hey all! Storm here.[/p][p]Just wanted to stop in and give you all an update on how work is going on chapter 3. We're currently working on the second-to-last major scene of the chapter (though for some of you, it'll be the final major scene, depending on your choices). Once this and the final scene complete, Slockie will be putting the final touches on the code and then we'll be sending the game to our beta testers.[/p][p]We'll be announcing a release once our testers have the build in-hand. If you'd like to be among the first to hear details on release dates and other details, consider joining our [url="https://discord.gg/AlterWorlds"]Discord server[/url]. You'll be among the first to get updates, see preview images, special renders from Slockie (like the cover art for this announcement), and a whole lot more. We talk about all things gaming there as well, especially other adult games, so if you're looking to find more games like [i]Heaven's Door[/i] or [i]Bare Witness[/i], it's a great place to start.[/p][p]And that's it! We appreciate you being here, and we are grateful for your support. Keep an eye open for an announcement on release in the near future![/p][p]Storm[/p]
